services.desc: SpiritHorse Equine Assisted Services exists to connect people and horses with the goal of empowering their lives through compassion and healing. Our program is inclusive, catering to all abilities, with a focus on enriching the lives of individuals confronting developmental, emotional, social, and physical hurdles through lessons, camps, and classes Our Homeschool Enrichment Program with horseback riding and animals is a hands-on, nature-based learning experience designed to support academic growth, social development, and emotional wellness. Students participate in weekly sessions that combine horseback riding instruction, animal care, and outdoor exploration in a safe, supportive ranch
